author: D00ZiE
body:
This item is pretty simple.
It will cost 10 points, basically what happens is you completely refill your kit.
For example, if you were to use all of your snowballs with the freezer kit, you could buy "Kit Refill" for 10 points and you would get all of your snowballs back.

New: 20 points to Refill all your teams kits.
